response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), station_avg AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS st_avg FROM joined GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation), phase_avg AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(st_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM station_avg GROUP BY lunarstage), phase_cnt AS (SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM joined GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT c.lunarstage AS lunar_phase, a.avg_bandwidth_usage, c.telescope_count, CAST(c.telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined) AS fraction_of_total FROM phase_cnt c JOIN phase_avg a ON a.lunarstage IS c.lunarstage;

assumptions.assumption: The total telescope count in the fraction's denominator covers only telescopes that match an observatory (after the inner join drops unmatched ones), not all rows in telescopes.
Each observatory station has one lunarstage value (it is the primary key), so grouping stations by phase is unambiguous. A NULL lunarstage forms its own group.
